cases.description: When the ExecutionConfig reports annotationCollectionEnabled = true, the method should return false (no short‑circuit).
When the ExecutionConfig reports annotationCollectionEnabled = false, the method should return true (short‑circuit is allowed).
Passing a null ExecutionContext should cause a NullPointerException because the method dereferences executionContext.
When ExecutionContext.getExecutionConfig() returns null, the method attempts to call isAnnotationCollectionEnabled() on a null reference, resulting in a NullPointerException.
If ExecutionConfig.isAnnotationCollectionEnabled() throws a RuntimeException, the method propagates that exception without handling it.
Even if isAnnotationCollectionEnabled() is called multiple times (e.g., via a spy), the result remains false when the flag is true.
Even if isAnnotationCollectionEnabled() is called multiple times, the result remains true when the flag is false.
When ExecutionContext.getExecutionConfig() throws a RuntimeException, the method should propagate that RuntimeException.
When ExecutionContext.getExecutionConfig() throws a NullPointerException, the method should propagate that NullPointerException.
